name: @nodeboot/ai-anthropic
description: Anthropic Claude Chat model adapter for Node-Boot AI
author: Manuel Santos <ney.br.santos@gmail.com>

scripts.pretest: pnpm run clean:build && pnpm run build
scripts.test:coverage: node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='src/**/*.test.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='src/**/*.spec.ts' --test --test-reporter node-test-reporter --test-reporter-destination stdout --test-reporter lcov --test-reporter-destination coverage/lcov.info --require ts-node/register test/**/*.{test,it.test}.ts
